stem_book: A container with CaCO₃(s) ⇌ CaO(s) + CO₂(g) has equilibrium at 1 atm (constant temperature). If volume is increased, how do the pressure (immediately on expansion) and the direction of shift change? (a) Pressure increases, forward (b) Pressure decreases, forward (c) Pressure decreases, backward (d) No effect
reason: Added 'immediately on expansion' and constant T: at the new equilibrium pCO2 returns to Kp = 1 atm
work: pCO2 drops below Kp -> forward until pCO2 = Kp
